Bold black ink outlines — BLAZING CRIMSON koi ascending spiral full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID PINK sakura petal cascade filling every gap, NO airbrush NO gradient wash. Background: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length side view with the camera at waist height, her body in clean profile, the whole figure from the soles of the shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so her extreme height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
